title: System1’s 2024 Wrapped: A Year of AI, Automation & Scale
body_markdown:
###


#### System1’s 2024 Wrapped: AI, Automation & Scale


2024 was nothing short of transformative for System1 — a year defined by


[innovation](https://system1.com/blog/ramp2024) , meaningful


[impact](https://system1.com/blog/bellwetherpublisher)


and a laser focus on


[AI](https://system1.com/blog/genaivideoads)


and automation.


From


[advancements](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A3-259wRRW8)


that redefined possibilities in our business


[to achievements](https://www.google.com/ads/publisher/stories/system1/)


that propelled our vision forward, we took big swings and saw


[even bigger results](https://system1.com/blog/dataiku) **.**


####


#####


####


#### **10 highlights from System1’s 2024 wrapped:**


1. Accelerated **[generative application development](https://www.dataiku.com/stories/detail/system1/)** : Smarter, faster campaigns


2. **700%+**


increase in rate of our ad campaign launches


3. Accelerated generative text capabilities; 3x boost to


[Publishing’s](https://system1.com/what-we-do#brands)


productivity


4. Scaled[genAI video ads](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j0Sx2I6BJQg)


5.[CouponFollow](https://couponfollow.com/) became the **#1** coupon site


6. Launched the **[Startpage App](https://www.startpage.com/privacy-please/featured-article/the-startpage-app-has-launched)** on **[iOS](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/startpage-private-browser/id6478921430)** and[Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.startpage.app&hl=en_US&pli=1)


7. Launched[Private Maps](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mapquest.android.private&hl=en_US) by[MapQuest](https://www.mapquest.com/)


8. **40** new hires joined the System1 team


9. Waterloo Area[Top Employer](https://system1.com/press/topemployer2024)


10. Built In’s 2024[Best Places to Work](https://system1.com/press/2024bestplacestowork)


#### As we wrap 2024, we’re excited for what’s ahead in 2025. Happy New Year


from System1!
